window._comment: Optional. Only rows whose permit window OVERLAPS [start, end] are fetched (SODA $where). Set to null for a full pull. Filters EVENT time (permit dates), not observation time: there are no snapshots before the first run.

schema._comment: Verified against live schema 2026-11-06. Columns: uniqueid, segmentid, oft, onstreetname, fromstreetname, tostreetname, borough_code, work_start_date, work_end_date, purpose, the_geom (+ Socrata :id/:created_at/:updated_at/:version, which change on the city's weekly full reload and are NOT stable).

advisory._comment: Secondary adapter: NYC DOT Weekly Traffic Advisory HTML page. Temporary/event closures; excludes emergency and long-term construction. NOT interchangeable with the API dataset — kept in its own history.
